Authentic LOW-RESOLUTION pixel-art battle sprites, like premium 16-bit era RPG / Slay-the-Spire-sized battle characters: chunky readable pixels, about 32 colors per sprite, clean dark 1-pixel outline, simple 2-3 tone shading, strong silhouette. Much simpler than the attached detailed illustrations — keep the same person (face, hair, colors, outfit, weapon) but simplified for small size. No anti-aliasing, no blur, no text, no UI.

Give each character a clearly distinct face — eye shape, brows, mouth, face shape and expression habits that fit their personality — instead of the same generic pretty face. Poses also fit the personality: a natural, specific pose with weight and intent, not a generic glamour pose.

This is a 4-star character: one flashy signature prop or accessory, otherwise clean.

시그룬 (sigrun): a noble knight woman in her late 20s. Long blond hair, silver armor with wing ornaments, a white feather cape, a long lance, a dignified expression. Accent colors: silver and white.
A battle sprite sheet of this ONE character: eight poses on one 1536x1024 canvas, split into eight equal cells of 384x512 (4 columns x 2 rows), reading order left to right, top to bottom. Keep an empty transparent margin of about 6% inside every cell edge — no part of a figure or effect may touch or cross a cell edge (the sheet is cut exactly on the cell lines). No borders, no grid lines, no gutters, no labels or text.
- Cell 1 — IDLE: standing in a ready battle stance
- Cell 2 — WINDUP: the anticipation just before her attack — body coiled, weight on the back foot, weapon pulled back
- Cell 3 — ATTACK: the peak of her basic attack, lunging or striking toward the RIGHT with her weapon fully extended (no slash trail or effect — drawn separately)
- Cell 4 — SKILL: a strong casting pose (hand, weapon or staff raised), NO glow or magic effect drawn — effects are drawn separately
- Cell 5 — GUARD: bracing defensively, knees bent, weapon or arm raised in front like a shield (no barrier effect)
- Cell 6 — HURT: just got hit, recoiling back to the LEFT, wincing, no blood
- Cell 7 — DOWN: knocked out, kneeling or collapsed on the ground, eyes closed, no blood
- Cell 8 — VICTORY: a confident, stylish win pose fitting her personality
All eight cells are the SAME sprite redrawn by one pixel artist: identical face, hair shape, outfit details, palette and outline in every cell — only the pose changes.
BODY ONLY: draw just the character and what she holds or wears. NO magic effects, NO glow, NO sparkles or particles, NO slash trails, NO companion creature, pet or familiar, NO projectiles, NO ground shadow — the game draws those as separate layers.
In every cell: exactly the same character size and proportions (adult about 1:6.5 head-to-body, NOT chibi), the figure as LARGE as the cell allows (about 70-80% of the cell height; draw it smaller if a long weapon, ponytail or cape would otherwise reach a cell edge — the game evens out the size, but nothing may touch an edge), feet on the same line near the bottom of the cell, facing RIGHT toward the enemies (except HURT recoiling), the whole body and effect inside its own cell. Fully transparent background. Native resolution 96x128 pixels per cell (384x256 for the whole sheet), upscaled exactly 4x with nearest-neighbor.

Authentic low-resolution pixel art. No anti-aliasing, no smooth gradients, no blur, no fine details smaller than one pixel. Fine, detailed pixel art (like a premium modern pixel gacha game): crisp pixel clusters, careful pixel shading on hair, eyes, skin and fabric, flat colors with a little dithering, clean dark 1-pixel outlines. Match the attached style reference (style/akane_c.png) in pixel size, detail level and color richness. Night mood: deep navy and violet base colors, warm orange lantern light, white and gold starlight. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no UI, no speech bubbles.

An item icon sheet on one 1024x1024 canvas, split into sixteen equal square cells of 256x256 (4x4), reading order left to right, top to bottom. Keep an empty transparent margin of about 6% inside every cell edge — no part of a figure or effect may touch or cross a cell edge (the sheet is cut exactly on the cell lines). No borders, no grid lines, no gutters, no labels or text. One icon per cell, centered, readable at small size, bold dark outline, consistent style across all icons.
